question: Estimate the bank branches a digital-first new bank (e.g., a hypothetical neobank getting full bank license) would need for India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Combination of physical branches + ATMs + Banking Correspondents (BC)? Branches.
Goal: meet RBI banking outreach norms + customer trust? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian banking norms: 25% branches must be in unbanked rural areas.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: For 50M target customers at modern private bank ratio: 50M / 5,000 = 10,000 branches (impractical).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 25% branches must be in unbanked rural areas.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: For 50M target customers at modern private bank ratio

benchmarkAssumptions.value: aim for ~2,000-2,500 branches for trust + rural compliance, with BCs handling rural reach.

calculationFlow: For 50M target customers at modern private bank ratio: 50M / 5,000 = 10,000 branches (impractical).
More realistic for digital-first: aim for ~2,000-2,500 branches for trust + rural compliance, with BCs handling rural reach.
